learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the ability to plan, design, conduct, and evaluate experiments in the field of experimental simulation (lifetime / structural analysis).
Acquire knowledge of methods in lifetime analysis and experimental structural analysis.
Be able to evaluate and discuss experimental results and know the possibilities and limitations of the methods.
Gain insight into the acquisition of load data and collectives.
Be enabled, through practical examples, to solve problems regarding lifetime predictions/structural analyses.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals in statistics and measurement technology and in the field of lifetime/structural analysis
Project work with a specific task

assessment_methods.method: Project with written elaboration (5-25 pages) and oral presentation (15 min)
